Is this permissable or not? If yes, please tell me the reasons why? As I have heard this is not allowed. Question: In Ramadhan an alim from India prays 40 daruds loudly in a gathering after his bayaan. Is this permissable or not? If yes, please tell me the reasons why? As I have heard this is not allowed. Answer ID: 708 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 299=293/M) Durood Sharif is a cause of barakah and blessing in itself; therefore there is nothing wrong in reciting durood after sermons, but sticking to reciting durood forty times after sermon collectively and loudly is not approved. Yes, if anyone recites durood loudly for people inconstantly then there is no matter whatsoever. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
